q: You start using Claude Code on an existing repository that has no CLAUDE.md. What does `/init` do?

options.text: Scans the codebase and writes a starter CLAUDE.md for you to refine
Creates `.claude/settings.json` with the team's permission rules
Indexes the repo into a vector store for retrieval during sessions
Installs the plugins listed in the project's marketplace file

explain: `/init` scans the codebase and generates a starter CLAUDE.md. Validate and refine it with test commands, framework conventions, no-touch paths and non-default style choices.

q: A developer wants fewer permission prompts during routine work but still wants a safety net. Which permission mode fits?

options.text: `auto`, which gates actions with a classifier
`bypassPermissions`, which silences all prompts
`plan`, which blocks every edit and command
`default`, which prompts before nearly everything

explain: `auto` is classifier-gated: fewer prompts without losing the safety net. `bypassPermissions` silences every prompt and also skips the protected-path guard, so it isn't a safe way to reduce interruptions.

q: You want a production deploy procedure that Claude never starts on its own, only when you type its name. How should you package it?

options.text: A file in `.claude/commands/`, the current command format
A skill with `disable-model-invocation: true` in frontmatter
A rule in CLAUDE.md asking Claude not to deploy unprompted
A `PostToolUse` hook that runs the deploy after each edit

explain: Skills are now the recommended format for commands, invoked as `/skill-name`. Setting `disable-model-invocation: true` means it runs only when called explicitly. `.claude/commands/` is the legacy format.

q: You have API-specific conventions that should load only when Claude works on files under `src/api/`. Where should they go?

options.text: At the top of CLAUDE.md under an API heading
A rules file with a `paths` glob in its frontmatter
A rules file saved in a `.claude/rules/api/` folder
A `SessionStart` hook that prints the conventions

explain: Rules files in `.claude/rules/` are scoped by a `paths` glob in YAML frontmatter, and load only when Claude works with matching files. The folder a rule sits in is organizational only, and CLAUDE.md loads every session.

q: When does Claude Code load the project's CLAUDE.md?

options.text: Only when Claude decides the task needs it
In full at every session start, before your first message
Only when you run `/init` at the start of a session
Only when files in the project root are edited

explain: CLAUDE.md is read from the project root at every session start, and its full contents are loaded before your first message, unconditionally. That is why its size dilutes every rule in it.

q: You want a script to check required environment variables whenever a Claude Code session starts or resumes. Which hook event fits?

options.text: `SessionStart`
`PostToolUse`
`Stop`
`Notification`

explain: `SessionStart` fires when a session starts or resumes, and is used to set up state, validate env vars and check services. `Stop` fires when the model finishes responding, `PostToolUse` after a tool call.
